author: Jane Thomas
story_en: Dora wakes to a beautiful day and decides it is perfect for a picnic. She gathers what she needs and sets out to discover which friends will join the outdoor meal. Main character: Dora the Explorer.
notes: Edition note: Originally published 2014; Series: Nickelodeon Dora the Explorer

author: 馮晞華
story_zh: 鳥兒學校終於開學，鴉鴉第一個來到課室。清晨裡滿是青草香，他一邊等候，一邊好奇哪些鳥兒會成為新同學。主要人物：鴉鴉。
notes: 頁數: 32頁; 適讀年齡: 3–6歲; 版本: 2021年初版; 文字: 繁體中文

title_en: That's not my dragon…: its ears are too fluffy
author: Fiona Watt
story_en: A touchy-feely board book. Readers stroke five different dragons — too bumpy, too soft, too spiky — hunting for 'my' dragon, with a little white mouse hiding on every page. Main characters: the five dragons and the hidden mouse.

author: Roger Hargreaves
story_en: Mr. Greedy loves eating everything in sight. One day he wanders into a giant's cave and is forced to eat an enormous meal, learning that too much of a good thing hurts. He promises never to be greedy again. Main characters: Mr. Greedy and the giant.

author: Greg Paprocki
story_en: A counting board book that counts down from 10 to Halloween. Toddlers spot hidden objects in spooky-cute fall scenes — corn mazes, costumes, pumpkins — until the big night arrives. Main characters: the trick-or-treaters in each scene.

author: Jason Tharp
story_en: Josie is struggling to make the art in her heart and feels she isn't good enough. Cherry the Fairy appears with funny rhymes, showing Josie that everyone — even fairies — battles self-doubt, and that she can create anyway. Main characters: Josie and Cherry the Fairy.

title_en: Peppa Pig and the nature walk
author: Neville Astley & Mark Baker (creators)
story_en: On a sunny day Peppa's family takes a nature walk after a picnic lunch. They spot ladybugs, baby birds and funny clouds from Peppa's nature book, while Daddy Pig — chased off by a wasp — is found at the end. Main characters: Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig.

author: Patricia Lakin
story_en: Tow Truck Mo mambos while he works. When a fancy sports car gets trapped in a muddy puddle, Mo rolls in to help. The rescue splashes through the mud and may turn his solo routine into a cheerful duet. Main character: Mo the tow truck.
notes: Series: Tow Truck Mo series, Level 1

author: Patricia Lakin
story_en: Hamsters Max and Mo visit their school's science fair and admire the children's projects. Inspired, they try an experiment of their own by planting seeds and watching them grow. Main characters: Max and Mo.

author: Patricia Lakin
story_en: Corn-loving hamsters Max and Mo decide to try apples. They go apple picking, make applesauce, and create an apple craft, discovering that new foods and activities can be fun. Main characters: Max and Mo.

title_en: Angelina Ballerina and the tea party
author: Katharine Holabird
story_en: Angelina, a dancing mouse, invites all her ballet academy friends to a tea party. She prepares cookies, cakes, and beautiful decorations, hoping every guest will have a wonderful time. Will Angelina's careful plans make it the best tea party ever? Main character: Angelina.

author: Amelia Hepworth
story_en: This interactive board book introduces tractors through bold, brightly coloured pictures and die-cut holes. Young readers explore the machine's main parts and discover how they work together to help on the farm. Main subject: tractors and how they work.
notes: Series: How it works; Format: Board book with die-cut holes

author: Eric Seltzer
story_en: Bunny booksellers spend a busy day welcoming animal customers. They help browsers, host storytime, and match every reader with the right book to take home. Main characters: the bookstore bunnies and their animal customers.

author: Maggie Testa
story_en: At library storytime, Daniel Tiger and O the Owl find a pop-up book they want to hear. O keeps noticing other tempting books, so Uncle X helps him focus on and enjoy one story at a time. Main characters: Daniel Tiger, O the Owl, and Uncle X.

author: Emma J. Virjan
story_en: Captain Cat and his copilot, Pilot Matt, want an adventure. They climb into their spaceship and blast off to Mars, where friendly aliens are waiting on the red planet. Main characters: Captain Cat, Pilot Matt, and the Martian friends.

author: Jane Yolen
story_en: A young fish becomes the assistant school crossing guard and helps classmates travel safely across the current. When a little crab needs help, the young fish acts bravely, makes the rescue, and earns everyone's admiration. Main character: the young fish.
notes: Series: School of Fish; Ready-to-Read Level 1

author: Jane Yolen
story_en: It is field day at fish school, and teams line up to race through the water. The young fish feel nervous and excited, then work together amid shouts and splashes. Main characters: the narrator's fish team and their school rivals.

author: 華婭婭
publisher: 双美生活文創股份有限公司 · 2025年7月
story_zh: 孩子甚麼都想要，卻發現貪心會帶來麻煩。面對一次只能選一個的規則，他學習作出取捨，明白不貪心才更能珍惜擁有，玩得開心。
notes: Series: 為什麼小繪本系列; Pages: 24頁; Reading age: 3歲以上

author: 華婭婭
publisher: 双美生活文創股份有限公司 · 2025年7月
story_zh: 浩浩只愛吃肉，蔬菜水果全都拒絕，還大喊不要吃胡蘿蔔。看見挑食令營養不均衡，他開始嘗試不同食物，踏出健康成長第一步。主要人物：浩浩。
notes: Series: 為什麼小繪本系列; Pages: 24頁; Reading age: 3歲以上

author: 華婭婭
publisher: 双美生活文創股份有限公司 · 2025年7月
story_zh: 琪琪答應媽媽不買玩具，卻在店前看見遙控飛機後哭鬧耍賴。她看見耍賴會失去信任，學會遵守約定，為自己的承諾負責。主要人物：琪琪。
notes: Series: 為什麼小繪本系列; Format: 24頁精裝 · 注音版; Reading age: 3歲以上

title_zh: 世界上最有禮貌的大怪獸.班巴魯班
author: Q-rais
publisher: 幼獅文化事業股份有限公司 · 2024年12月
story_zh: 可愛的大怪獸班巴魯班從海裡現身，帶著禮物有禮地自我介紹。孩子跟著牠練習問候、道謝和尊重別人，學做懂禮貌的好孩子。主要人物：班巴魯班。

author: 艾德．維爾 (Ed Vere)
publisher: 維京國際股份有限公司 · 2020年8月
story_zh: 溫柔的獅子雷納德愛寫詩、散步和發白日夢，也有一位愛寫詩的鴨子朋友。其他獅子說他不像獅子，雷納德便用自己的方式思考：怎樣才算真正的獅子？主要人物：雷納德。
notes: Format: 40頁精裝 · 注音版; Original title: How to be a Lion

title_zh: 你不可以打我：面對問題不逃避
author: 楊胡平
publisher: 京采文教事業有限公司 · 2023年7月
story_zh: 繪本透過生活情境幫助孩子認識霸凌，學會辨識危險、遠離傷害和保護自己。面對問題時不逃避，勇敢說出「你不可以打我」，並向可信任的大人求助。

author: 苅田澄子
publisher: 大穎文化事業股份有限公司 · 2025年2月
story_zh: 媽媽請丹丹買紅蘿蔔和馬鈴薯。途中硬幣掉進洞、帽子被水沖走，又迷了路，菜店更售罄馬鈴薯。動物朋友伸出援手，丹丹也學會隨機應變，完成任務。主要人物：丹丹。
notes: Format: 40頁精裝 · 注音版; Original title: たんたのたいへんなおつかい

title_zh: 我不喜歡你摸我：提高自我保護意識
author: 楊胡平
publisher: 京采文教事業有限公司 · 2023年7月
story_zh: 繪本以生活情境帶孩子認識霸凌與不當觸碰，學會辨識危險、遠離傷害並保護自己。不舒服時勇敢說「我不喜歡你摸我」，再向可信任的大人求助。

author: 華婭婭
publisher: 双美生活文創股份有限公司 · 2025年6月
story_zh: 孩子堅持己見又不聽勸告，看見任性帶來的後果後，學會體諒別人、好好溝通，明白不任性才能與大家玩得更開心。
notes: Format: 24頁; Reading age: 3歲以上; Series: 為什麼小繪本系列

author: 華婭婭
story_zh: 為什麼不能亂發脾氣？這本繪本帶孩子認識情緒，學習好好表達生氣，不亂發脾氣。

author: 陸趙鈞鴻、黃陸永恩
story_zh: 晶晶迎接國慶節，透過繪本故事認識節日由來與慶祝活動，還可使用點讀功能邊聽邊學，感受節日氣氛。主要人物：晶晶。
notes: Series: 幼兒節期書（點讀）; Format: 點讀繪本

author: 陸趙鈞鴻、黃陸永恩
story_zh: 晶晶準備聖誕表演，在輕鬆愉快的過程中學習新知識、技能和正面價值，還可用點讀筆聽兒歌。主要人物：晶晶。
notes: Series: 晶晶的生活記趣（點讀）; Format: 點讀繪本

author: 陸趙鈞鴻、黃陸永恩
story_zh: 晶晶迎接重陽節，透過繪本故事認識敬老孝親的傳統習俗，還可使用點讀功能邊聽邊學。主要人物：晶晶。
notes: Series: 幼兒節期書（點讀）; Format: 點讀繪本

author: 郭思穎、姚睿祉
publisher: 小樹苗教育出版有限公司 · 2019年
story_zh: 調皮可愛的石仔以淘氣小故事帶孩子認識正確好行為，在成長中建立良好品格；書末亦附臨床心理學家撰寫的小錦囊。主要人物：石仔。
notes: Series: 淘氣孩子鬥一番兒童成長系列：好行為篇

author: 郭思穎 / 姚睿祉
story_zh: 淘氣孩子鬥一番系列。超級大話精最愛吹牛，牛皮越吹越大，最後怎麼收場呢？幽默故事帶孩子明白誠實的重要。

author: 陸趙鈞鴻、黃陸永恩
story_zh: 晶晶動手做月餅，認識不同味道的月餅和應節食品，再與家人吃月餅、賞月和玩花燈。兒歌可用點讀筆播放，一起感受中秋歡樂。主要人物：晶晶。
notes: Series: 晶晶的生活記趣（點讀）; Format: 點讀繪本

author: 郭思穎 / 姚睿祉
story_zh: 淘氣孩子鬥一番系列。小火山快要爆發了！怒氣沖沖的時候，該怎麼辦？跟著故事學習冷靜下來的方法。

author: 郭思穎、姚睿祉
publisher: 小樹苗教育出版社有限公司 · 2020年9月
story_zh: 淘氣的石仔透過四個生活小故事，面對成長中的難題，學習以正確態度處事；書後亦附臨床心理學家撰寫的好態度小錦囊。主要人物：石仔。
notes: Series: 淘氣孩子鬥一番兒童成長系列：好態度篇

author: 陸趙鈞鴻博士、黃陸永恩
story_zh: 這本中文童謠歌謠集邀請親子共讀共唱，在愉快歌聲中學習基礎知識和正面價值觀，同時培養想像力與創意。
notes: Series: 晶晶兒童系列; Format: 中文童謠歌謠集

author: 郭思穎、姚睿祉
publisher: 小樹苗教育出版社有限公司
story_zh: 石仔與同學在公園打口水戰後，常用吐口水表達不滿，惹姐姐生氣。石媽教他正確管理情緒，幫助他改掉壞習慣。主要人物：石仔。
notes: Series: 淘氣孩子鬥一番兒童成長系列—好習慣篇; Format: 31頁平裝; Reading age: 3–6歲

author: Jason Tharp
story_en: Josie struggles to create the art in her heart and worries she is not good enough. Cherry the Fairy arrives with playful rhymes, showing that even fairies face self-doubt and that Josie can keep creating. Main characters: Josie and Cherry the Fairy.

author: Paul Brett Johnson
story_en: Laura spends a summer Saturday with her parents and older brother Mitch selling their produce at a farmers' market in Lexington, Kentucky. She helps at the stand and makes time to play with her friend Betsy. Main characters: Laura, Mitch, their parents, and Betsy.

title_en: How to get your teacher ready
author: Jean Reagan
story_en: A class offers playful instructions for getting their teacher ready for the school year, from the first day and picture day to concerts, field day, and graduation. The funny role reversal quietly helps the children prepare too. Main characters: the students and their teacher.

author: Karma Wilson
story_en: Big Bear and small Mouse walk through the woods with their friends, noticing opposites such as high and low, fast and slow, and quiet and loud. At sunset, everyone gathers in Bear's lair. Main characters: Bear, Mouse, Badger, Rabbit, Owl, Wren, Mole, and Gopher.

author: Tom Percival
story_en: Tilda likes her life exactly as it is, so sudden change makes her world feel upside down. Inspired by a determined ladybug, she learns to keep trying and move forward when things are difficult. Main characters: Tilda and the ladybug.

title_en: A unicorn, a dinosaur, and a shark walk into a book
author: Jonathan Fenske
story_en: An unseen narrator tries to make a unicorn, a dinosaur, and a shark perform in a brilliant story, but the three characters keep objecting and refusing to cooperate. A surprise kitten joins the fourth-wall-breaking fun. Main characters: Unicorn, Dinosaur, Shark, the narrator, and the kitten.

author: Christine Ricci
story_en: The Grumpy Old Troll is rude to his friend Mouse. Dora and Boots step in and help him practise polite words such as “please” and “thank you.” As he treats his friend with care, the once-grumpy troll discovers how good it feels to use kind manners. Main character: the Grumpy Old Troll.

author: Sabrina Moyle
story_en: An exuberant tiger cheers readers through challenges and milestones, encouraging them to be brave, help friends, stand for what is right, and change course when needed. Main characters: the cheering tiger, a multicoloured-striped white tiger, and other animal friends.

title_en: Where's Waldo?: the great games speed search
author: Martin Handford
story_en: Think you can beat a friend at finding Waldo? Challenge accepted! Sports, games and contests take the spotlight in this speed-search adventure across action-filled spreads, from a soccer match to dragon aerobatics.

author: Linda Armstrong
story_en: Pooh's honey pot is empty, so he floats up to a beehive with a balloon, pretending to be a little black rain cloud. The bees see through it and chase him off. At Rabbit's house he eats all the honey and gets stuck in the front door. After days with no food, he is thin enough to be pulled free — and lands in another honey tree.

author: 丸山奈央
story_zh: 太郎生日那天，廚房裡的通心粉們都想變成最驚喜的料理，卻被壞心眼的貓咪嘲笑不會成功。牠們成群結隊擅作主張，要給大家一個大驚喜。

author: 丸山奈央
story_zh: 擅長調味的神奇盤子，經它手的食物都變得美味好吃。一天媽媽不小心打破了它，它以為自己會被丟掉而絕望，沒想到憑著毅力和樂觀，迎來了意想不到的結局。

author: 李定原
story_zh: 父母的話有時會在不知不覺中變成孩子的壓力。這本親子繪本邀請孩子說出最想聽到的話，讓親子溝通多一點溫暖。

title_zh: 丁丁培養好習慣篇: 不守規則的丁丁
author: 袁妙霞
story_zh: 丁丁和家人朋友一起經歷不同的體驗，從日常小事培養好習慣、養成良好品德。「我有正能量」系列之一，按正向心理學的品格強項編寫。

title_zh: 加油! 不要放棄!: 勇氣
author: 袁妙霞
story_zh: 小女孩夢夢和家人朋友一起探索世界，從挫折中學會勇氣。這是「我有正能量」系列的勇氣篇，圍繞正向心理學的品格優勢，陪孩子認識情緒、面對困難。

author: 娜歐蜜．瓊斯
story_zh: 圓形喜歡和形狀朋友們玩疊高塔遊戲，可怎麼疊都不夠穩。當大家都想放棄時，圓形說：「再試一次！」它是暢銷繪本《什麼形狀，都行！》的續集，鼓勵孩子不放棄、接納差異。

author: 白冰
story_zh: 認知黑和白的啟蒙圖畫書：小白豆、大黑豆，都是豆；小白鴨、大黑鴨，都是鴨。帶孩子在相同與不同之中，感受團結、平等和友愛。

author: 丸山奈央
story_zh: 兔子嗶啵非常喜歡麵包，滿腦子都只想著麵包，有一天竟然請麵包師傅把他當成麵包來製作。沒有客人想要「兔子麵包」，但麵包師傅給了他一個好主意。

author: 丸山奈央
story_zh: 麵包店裡最受歡迎的是紅豆麵包，師傅一次失手做出了一個「洞洞」麵包。他身旁全是餡料滿滿的朋友，只有他有一個洞，沒想到最後他反而被另一群客人喜愛，成了超人氣麵包。

title_zh: 5分鐘床邊有聲故事：節日故事.中秋節
story_zh: 中秋節主題的五分鐘床邊有聲故事。(內容未經核實)

author: Stuart Heritage
story_en: Jonathan the Magic Pony can make anything disappear with one wave of his wand. But when he magics away Sarah's bear, it doesn't come back, and silly chaos follows. A very funny read for fans of Supertato.

title_en: This book is full of unicorns
author: Gareth Peter
story_en: Unicorns hide throughout our busy world. Readers search lively scenes at a funfair, a creepy castle, and even space to spot cheeky unicorns doing funny things. Main characters: the hidden unicorns and the reader searching for them.

title_en: How Carrot and Cookie saved Christmas
author: Erica S. Perl
story_en: On Christmas Eve, best friends Carrot and Cookie find Santa too sick to fly. They take over his sleigh, helped by flying vegetables, and deliver the presents. Main characters: Carrot, Cookie, Santa, and the flying vegetables.

author: Philip Ardagh
story_en: On a rainy train ride, Penny sees a tiger's tail and paw, though Daddy thinks she is imagining things. The disguised tiger finally leaps out to rescue a baby's fallen teddy. Main characters: Penny, Daddy, the tiger, and the baby.

author: Becky Hemsley
story_en: A girl feels overwhelmed by other people's expectations about how loud, quiet, fierce, or gentle she should be. She finds a special place to express her feelings, breathe, and be herself. Main character: the girl.

author: Benji Davies
story_en: Bizzy Bear visits a farm, following tracks to meet chickens, feed pigs, and ride a horse. The interactive journey builds farm vocabulary through hands-on play. Main character: Bizzy Bear and the farm animals.

author: Ameet Studio
story_en: Help the rangers on the LEGO City wildlife reserve look after the safari animals! Push, pull and slide the tabs to feed the swinging monkeys, guide a lost elephant home, and discover all the animals.

title_en: Bluey: Let's Play Verandah Santa: A Lift-the-Flap Book
author: Bluey
story_en: A brand new lift-the-flap book for Christmas! It's Christmas Eve and Bluey's family are relaxing by the tree. Muffin wonders how Santa will get in. Bluey, Bingo and Muffin practise no peeking as Dad plays Verandah Santa!

author: Brian Russo
story_en: Yoga Bunny returns in this adorable, mindful friendship story. She teaches an anxious bear easy yoga poses, meditation warm-ups and deep breathing before a birthday party. Great for finding calm at home or in the classroom.

author: FunHouse師資團隊
story_zh: 浩浩因為怕被罵而說謊，老師和爸媽用溫暖的方式引導他承認錯誤。繪本教孩子誠實面對，也提醒要先保護自己，書末附家長指引。

title_zh: 孩子的SEL情緒認知四部曲 3: 我好難過
author: 麥可．伊恩．布萊克
story_zh: 紐約時報暢銷作家的幽默暖心之作。透過書中主角的溫暖互動，學習察覺自己與他人的低落情緒，對人付出關懷。

author: 瑪蒂德．塔奇尼
story_zh: 有一天小男孩的腦袋突然不見了！吃飯刷牙戴帽子全成了問題，連上學都聽不到老師說話。直到他遇見一名小女孩……一本幽默的義大利繪本，講迷糊小男孩的腦袋環遊世界。

title_zh: 夢想STEAM職業系列: 我是未來工程師
author: 辛妮．索馬拉
story_zh: 莎拉問：「飛機這麼重，怎樣會飛起來？」外婆說她有創意又愛解決問題，正是工程師的特質。跟著莎拉認識城市裡的機械和工程師，進入STEAM世界。

author: FunHouse師資團隊
story_zh: 「這是我的！才不要分給你！」帶孩子跨出分享的第一步，體會分享帶來的快樂。和《不說謊！》同系列的品格繪本。

title_zh: 超人力霸王爸爸回來了!
author: 宮西達也
story_zh: 超人力霸王爸爸和巴爾坦星人爸爸大比拼！兩個個性完全不同的爸爸，對孩子的愛卻是一樣的。宮西達也的經典父子繪本。

author: Ellie Peterson
story_en: Pufferfish does not always want a hug, and his ocean friends have to notice his signals. By asking first and respecting his space, they discover many caring ways to be friends. Main characters: Pufferfish and his sea-creature friends.

author: Pat-a-Cake
story_zh: 8種生活情境搭配揭頁遊戲，讓孩子翻出好的品格和生活態度。幫助幼兒建立正向價值觀，鼓勵發揮善與美的力量，溫柔對待別人和環境。

title_zh: 貓熊波波與企鵝樂樂.今天一起去露營
author: 郭飛飛
story_zh: 黑白好朋友貓熊波波和企鵝樂樂約好週末去露營，卻一再因生病延期。療癒系繪本，講友情、關懷與原諒，書末附家長指引，教孩子珍惜友誼、體諒別人。

title_en: Peppa's magical story: a magic wheel book
author: Peppa Pig
story_en: Peppa and her family enjoy a day out while a magic wheel reveals wonders from Peppa's imagination, including a unicorn and a mermaid. Turning the wheel changes the surprise and encourages children to retell the adventure. Main characters: Peppa and her family.

title_en: Once upon a time... there was a little bird: a tale about kindness
author: Maja Andersen
story_en: Little Bird breaks a wing and cannot fly south for winter. Kind voices offer shelter and food, showing how care can help someone through a difficult time. Main characters: Little Bird and the generous creatures it meets.

title_zh: 愛吃的星星王子：日本職棒海灣之星Starman閃亮登場
author: Yokohama DeNA Baystars
story_zh: 地板上突然出現可疑的腳印，食物也不見了！愛吃的星星王子決定跟著腳印調查到底。日本職棒橫濱DeNA海灣之星吉祥物STARMAN登場的繪本。

title_zh: 幼兒成長 1: 莫莫上學去
author: 吳佐晰 / 原著; 廖曉君 / 改寫
story_zh: 第一次上學，心裡一定有很多問題：該準備什麼？會遇到什麼？讓莫莫陪著孩子一起經歷開學的第一天，媽媽也陪著他走過擔心。

title_zh: 我們的情緒繪本 7: 蓋賓的害羞泡泡
author: 科奇卡
story_zh: 小兔子蓋賓最討厭害羞了。在泳池他交到了河狸朋友，回到教室卻又躲在柱子後面。他鼓起勇氣，逃離孤單。法國情緒教育繪本，在法國銷量超過25萬冊。
